content.value:
Named by the wave-1 s5 builder as out-of-slice, and confirmed by the reviewer; not filed until now.

Wave 1 taught templates/search-starter's GRAPH landing to record WHICH upstream condition emptied its bp-doc-id marker, so a HEALTH refusal names a 403 rather than a symptom. The LISTINGS landing (MapFinderLanding in app/(finder)/page.tsx, fed by lib/listings.ts) has the same shape: it can render with no anchorable document, emit an empty bp-doc-id, and fail the deploy gate closed with nothing recorded about why.

The value shaping already exists and is dependency-free after the wave-1 review fix: markers.corpusStatusMarkerValue in templates/search-starter/lib/markers.ts, pinned by lib/markers.corpus-status.test.ts. This slice is mostly wiring the listings read to carry its upstream status the same way, so the deploy row reads the same for both landings and the slice-2 classifier still sees ONE class.

Do NOT fabricate a doc id to make HEALTH pass — the gate failing closed is correct (site-spawner D72); the point is only to make the refusal legible.
